tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Models on the broker with benchmark scores per category (0–1, measured by us), price per 1M tokens (default USD, any currency from GET /api/v1/broker/currencies) and regions. Filter by category, region and price; sorted by score in the category, else by price.

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Sends messages to the broker (OpenAI chat completions). model defaults to `taylor` (strongest measured model); any id from list_models works. routing sets criteria per request, e.g. {"category": "coding", "level": "best"}. Needs Authorization: Bearer ast_sk_… — billed like the REST API.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "chat" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
